The only way to get that information is to obtain its ¹H NMR spectrum, which the proton_nmr_spectra tool can provide (it internally knows the SMILES of the compound in question). We'll request the spectrum and then count the distinct signals, which correspond to chemically equivalent hydrogen sets.</thought>
